Film 'Hanuman Ansh' Achieves Box Office Success Amid OTT Rejection

The film 'Hanuman Ansh' has achieved significant box office success, earning over 80 crore rupees. Director Vishal Chaturvedi shared that the film faced rejection from OTT platforms initially, which he described as an insult. He also questioned Bollywood's initial stance towards the film, contrasting it with its current success. The film's narrative, focusing on faith and simplicity, has resonated with audiences, with one report noting its comparison to a 1975 film that also saw success after a slow start. The film is reportedly based on Neem Karoli Baba.
